Observações e/ou Benefícios Adicionais

Sobre a Organização
Estamos há mais de 130 anos presentes no dia a dia dos brasileiros.

A nossa história como Grupo DPSP começa lá em 2011, com a fusão dessas redes de farmácias.

E desde então, os nossos mais de 30 mil colaboradores constroem novos capítulos dessa história diariamente, levando soluções de saúde para as milhares de pessoas que frequentam as nossas mais de 1.600 lojas e 6 centros de distribuição espalhados em 9 estados do Brasil e Distrito Federal.

No Grupo DPSP (lojas, corporativo e CDs), saúde vem em primeiro lugar, é com esse propósito que cuidamos todos os dias de milhões de brasileiros.
Seguimos com ética, respeito e excelência para ser a primeira escolha dos nossos clientes e colaboradores.E agora além de ser nosso cliente, você tem a chance de fazer parte do nosso time

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference, supporting the administrative and procurement implementation of projects and initiatives. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the Operational Team of UN-Habitat in Rio de Janeiro and HQs.
Work LocationRio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To meet with greater demand for projects' implementation, the office of Rio de Janeiro is looking for a Procurement Assistant that will be focusing on Brazil initiatives. The professional will be asked to assist the office team by contributing to the administrative and procurement of projects and initiatives. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Procurement Assistant will support the implementation of the projects in Brazil, with the following responsibilities: a. Support the administrative implementation of projects and initiatives, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. b. Support procurement processes for goods, services, and works, ensuring full compliance with organizational procurement rules, policies, and ethical standards. c. Plan, manage, and monitor procurement activities in line with approved project workplans, budgets, and timelines under supervision. d. Support the preparation of procurement documentation, including solicitation documents, evaluations, contracts, and purchase orders. e. Support procurement planning with programme, finance, and operations teams to ensure timely delivery and budget alignment. f. Help vendor sourcing, market research, and supplier evaluations to ensure value for money, transparency, and fairness. g. Monitor contract implementation, including deliverables, timelines, amendments, and closure, in coordination with relevant units. h. Maintain accurate and complete procurement records and ensure proper filing in corporate systems. i. Provide guidance and technical support to programme teams on procurement procedures and requirements. j. Identify procurement risks and propose mitigation measures to strengthen compliance and efficiency. k. Contribute to continuous improvement of procurement processes, tools, and templates. l. Assist in budget planning, monitoring, and revisions, including tracking expenditures against approved budgets, specially in relation to procurement. m. Support and follow up on financial transactions, such as payments, advances, reimbursements, and vendor contracts. n. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records for projects and operations. o. Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. p. Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. q. Monitor financial reporting timelines and contribute to the preparation of financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. r. Support audits and financial reviews by ensuring availability and organization of required documentation. s. Be responsible of for inventory and warehouse management. t. Write official letters in Portuguese. u. Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. v. Participate in missions as requested. w. Carry out other activities requested by the Head of Office and/or Program Officer within the framework of this consultancy, without prejudice to fulfilling their responsibilities. m. Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Procurement Assistant shall support the Program Officers in the proper planning and management of programmes' implementation related to the office's project portfolio, according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Administration, Administration, Economics, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience
A minimum of three (3) years of experience in program' implementation and projects in public administration or international organizations, administrative and financial issues, and/or related areas is required.
Demonstrated experience in administrative and finance is required.
Work experience within the United Nations System is desirable.
International experience is desirable, particularly in the field of international cooperation for development, urban development, and project management. Skills
Good computer skills in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) are required.
Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and/or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration SB-3 UNDP Brazil Salary Scale Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:
Cover memo (maximum 1 page)
Educational Background (incl. dates)
Professional Experience (assignments, tasks, achievements, duration by years/ months)
Expertise and preferences regarding location of potential assignments
Other Experience and Expertise (e.g. Internships/ voluntary work, etc.)* * Please note that Internships, self-employment and part-time count as 50%. In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. All applications should be submitted to: Inspira UN-HABITAT does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process. If you have any questions concerning people or companies claiming to be recruiting on behalf of these offices and requesting the payment of a fee, please contact:
No Fee

description:

O Grupo Invasive fornece produtos minimamente invasivos, seguros e de alta qualidade para os setores vascular, endovascular e hemodinâmica. Nosso compromisso com a excelência se reflete no atendimento, sempre alinhado à missão, visão e valores da empresa. Atuamos em hospitais públicos e privados, oferecendo suporte direto em cirurgias e visitas técnicas. Além disso, contamos com equipes administrativas, financeiras e de logística, responsáveis por otimizar processos, gerenciar estoques, garantir a eficiência nas entregas e manter a sustentabilidade financeira. Nossos times de recursos humanos e compliance asseguram um ambiente organizacional ético e inovador, fortalecendo nosso compromisso com a qualidade e a satisfação dos clientes.

Analista Financeiro (Contas a Receber) - Pleno.

Se você quer aplicar seus conhecimentos, aprender cada vez mais e evoluir profissionalmente, essa vaga pode ser o seu próximo passo

Por que você vai gostar de trabalhar aqui

  • Vale-transporte ou Vale Mobilidade (no valor da passagem para quem vem de carro ou Uber) - desconto de apenas 2% do valor da recarga;

  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – Plano Basic Plus subsidiado para o colaborador (disponível após o período de experiência);
  • Convênio com SESC – Benefícios exclusivos para lazer e bem-estar;
  • Intervalo para café – 15 minutos pela manhã e 15 minutos à tarde;
  • Comemorações mensais – Para aniversariantes ou cumprimento de metas;
  • Auxílio educacional – Para graduação, pós-graduação, cursos técnicos e idiomas (disponível após 1 ano de empresa);

Responsabilidades

  • Atender aos clientes internos e externos, disponibilizando informações, orientações e serviços relacionados à área de atuação;

At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high-performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across internal manufacturing operations.

Partner with the best

As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba), you will ensure technical requirements are properly implemented and verified throughout fabrication, assembly and validation activities inside our Curitiba plant. You will support audits, risk assessments, first article inspections, non‑conformance management and continuous improvement initiatives to guarantee flawless execution.

As the Quality Engineer, Product QA (In-house Curitiba) you will be responsible for:

  • Reviewing and improving in-house product quality performance on a frequent basis.
  • Collaborating with Lean initiatives to enable process improvements and flawless execution.
  • Leading first article inspection (FAI) processes internally, ensuring product and process alignment with requirements using risk assessment tools such as FMEA.
  • Conducting product quality audits and performing routine Gemba walks to validate compliance to technical specifications.
  • Acting as a risk assessor for manufacturing processes and mitigating identified execution risks.
  • Supporting and/or leading Go/No-Go reviews and facilitating pre-production meetings.
  • Capturing, resolving and communicating operational Lessons Learned to Supply Chain and Product Delivery teams.
  • Promoting quality culture by conducting continuous improvement workshops.
  • Identifying, reviewing and addressing product non-conformances and driving strategic corrective actions.
  • Implementing and monitoring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Communicating approaches and methods for solving complex quality issues.
  • Ensuring adherence to Product Line quality directives at fabrication sites.
  • Witnessing in-house product inspections and qualification activities.
  • Registering and escalating critical observations to the appropriate levels of the organization.
  • Leading manufacturing review processes for new first articles with relevant stakeholders.
  • Acting as an enabler for implementing Non‑Conformance Management processes within internal operations.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
  • Have fluent English skills.
  • Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea equipment fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
  • Have previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
  • Have experience performing quality and product requirement audits.
  • Have knowledge in product inspection processes and technical documentation analysis.
  • Have experience using quality tools such as A3, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, 5S and Lean Six‑Sigma.
  • Have strong leadership skills.
  • Have negotiation and influencing abilities with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Have the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
  • Have a Master's degree in a Quality‑related discipline. (Desirable)
  • Have technical qualification or certification in Dimensional, Painting, Welding, NDT or Fabrication inspection. (Desirable)

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

  • Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm or from 8am-5pm.
  • Location: Curitiba, PR.

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.
Requisitos
Windows Server: Administração de Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
Linux: Administração de distribuições como Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat, incluindo gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
Protocolos: Domínio de TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
Hardware: Configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
Serviços: Configuração e suporte a VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
Serviços de Nuvem: Gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
Virtualização: Domínio de ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
Storage: Gerenciamento de storages (NAS/SAN), protocolos iSCSI, Fibre Channel e gestão de LUNs.
Firewall: Configuração de regras em soluções como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
Backup: Implementação de políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
Monitoramento: Experiência com ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.
Diferenciais
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Conhecimento básico em Terraform ou Ansible.
Containers: Noções de Docker e Kubernetes.
Linguagens de Script: PowerShell ou Python para automatizar tarefas rotineiras.
Localidade da posição: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
This position is based on a Cruise Ship

Education and Experience Requirements

· Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.

· Hold a current valid medical license.

· Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.

· Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.

· Fluency in English.

· Strong interpersonal skills.

Reports to: Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to on onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures, safely and effectively, and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services, to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions, safely and effectively, to address the concerns of on board guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi–Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain the knowledge of the spa services and products in effort to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi – Spa Sales Consultant. Position requirements Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests Work closely with the Medi–Spa Sales Consultant Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality Excellent communication and listening skills Basic computer knowledge Must be a team player Duties and Responsibilities

· Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.

· Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld's medi-spa protocols.

· Conduct patient follow-up as required.

· Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.

· Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control

. · Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.

· Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager's office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O).

· Cross-promote other spa services.

· Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure. · Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required.

· Manage medical product and supply inventory.

· Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.

· Handle guests' questions and concerns professionally and courteously.

· Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.

· Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.

· Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.

· Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.

· Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.

· Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.

· Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies.

· Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report. General Guidelines

· For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.

· All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.

· At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. · Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.

· Clean your room and set up for your next guest.

· Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest. This means the room must be:

· Clean – sanitize work surfaces and sink area; store trash is proper receptacles.

· (biohazard/sharps/trash); All trash must be taken out daily or when full.

· Organized –stock boxes should be out of sight and all supplies must be organized or stored properly

. · Inviting – the treatment bed must be properly dressed and proper ambience with regards to music and temperature. End of Day Checklist

· Dispose of open unused needles

· Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full

· Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full

· Sterilize table and countertops

· Fill out inventory control form

· Lock product storage cabinets

· Lock treatment room

· Email daily revenue report to shore side team Service booking policy A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. A critical element to the success of our spa is our ability to work together as a team. If we are unable to work seamlessly together, our guest will be the first to notice. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:

· Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.

· In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.

· Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager's approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager's instructions. Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (known as 'GPS')

· Be familiar with OneSpaWorld's 'GPS' to safety. ·

Understand and practice the required self-screening procedures.

· Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.

· Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.

· Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.

· Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.

· Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time. · Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.

· Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.

· Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.

· Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.

· Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.

Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.

· Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.

· Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.

title: Network Solution Architect
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.
We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.
1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.
Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.
Position Overview
As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.
We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.
Key Responsibilities
Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer-centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non-functional and functional state-of-the-art
Communicates transparently to the whole business
Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement
Requirements
Must Have
Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
Familiar with cloud-based solutions and virtualization technologies
High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
Understands how big-picture goals inform technical details and vice-versa
Ability to work in complex environments (multi-cultural/multi-country/geographically distributed teams)
High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
Excellent communication and presentation skills
English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
Nice to Have
Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
Benefits
What we offer?
CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)
Why 1GLOBAL?
Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company

title: Gas Business Modeler
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Job Overview:
We are seeking a Gas Business Modeler to join our Gas Operations Technical Support Division (GOTSD) under Gas Operations Technical Support & Planning Department (GOTS&PD)
GOTSD is responsible for the strategic growth and optimization of the gas business, integrating technical expertise, and digital and technologies innovation. ITMG also oversees the Master Gas Network planning, while optimizing the gas supply portfolio through advanced modeling and cost-benefit frameworks. It focuses on deploying cutting-edge technologies—such as AI, IoT, and digital twins to deliver high-impact solutions to shape the future of gas operations.
Your primary role is to provide technical and analytical skills to support decision decision-making, design, optimization, and operational efficiency involved in gas process simulation, pipeline or network modeling, equipment performance modeling, or economic forecasting.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Maintain and apply mathematical, computational, or simulation models to support engineering design, operational analysis, project planning, and performance optimization in gas sector in order to simulate real-world conditions, test scenarios, and predict outcomes to guide engineering and business decisions.
Develop and maintain steady-state or dynamic simulation models using industry-standard software (e.g., HYSYS, PROSPER, GAP, PipePhase, etc.).
Create simulation models for process units, pipeline networks, production systems, or processing facilities.
Apply thermodynamic, hydraulic, or economic principles to ensure model accuracy.
Collect and validate data from field measurements, historical performance, or engineering studies.
Ensure data consistency and reliability for accurate modeling and forecasting.
Run simulations under various operating conditions or scenarios (e.g., equipment failure, capacity changes, production decline, new well connections).
Analyze results to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity limits, or optimization opportunities.
Recommend design or operational changes based on model findings.
Provide modeling support for FEED (front-end engineering Design ) studies, project design, and operational troubleshooting.
Support capital project evaluations and feasibility studies with technical insights from models.
Test and validate models against real-time or historical data to ensure accuracy.
Calibrate models to match field behavior and improve predictive capability.
Minimum requirements:
As the successful candidate you will hold a Bachelor degree in Engineering (preferably Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering)
You will have minimum of 10 years of experience in gas process modeling and simulation, preferably in gas sector.
Professional certifications (e.g., in simulation software or project economics) are preferred.
Experience in model-based decision support or digital transformation initiatives (e.g., digital twins, predictive analytics) is a plus.
You will have proficiency in Process simulation such as: HYSYS, PRO/II, Aspen Plus.
You will also have skills in production systems modeling such as: PROSPER, GAP, PIPESIM, Preferably with Pipeline network modeling such as: PLEXSYS, OLGA (for dynamic models).
You will have a strong understanding of Thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, mass and energy balances.
You will have experience in Data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Python, MATLAB, Power BI).
You will have experience in Economic modeling (e.g., NPV, IRR, cash flow projections), Preferably familiarity with Saudi Aramco standards and procedures.
You will also have analytical thinking and problem-solving skills as well as attention to details and accuracy in modeling.
Working environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

* Elaborar planos operacionais alinhados à estratégia da empresa.

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know our Team:
The Global Service Delivery (GSD) team is responsible for Agoda's office infrastructure and staff connectivity. We provide the hardware, software, and access to resources that allows staff to achieve their goals. We operate in 10 different countries, providing 24/7 support to all Agoda employees. Whether in the office, working remotely, or traveling, we enable everyone to stay connected. The GSD team uses state-of-the-art cloud management technologies combined with the best of on-site services to manage the latest hardware running Windows, macOS, and Linux.
The Opportunity:
As a Workday Specialist - Benefits, you'll be the go-to expert ensuring our Workday platform runs seamlessly and continues to evolve with the business. You'll take the lead on all things Benefits, while also strengthening our foundation across HCM, Security, and Reporting.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who loves diving deep into system design and data but also enjoys seeing the bigger picture - how technology can simplify work, enhance employee experience, and drive better decisions. You'll partner closely with People and IT teams to deliver scalable solutions, optimize existing processes, and explore new ways Workday and other tools can bring value to the organization.
If you're someone who enjoys solving complex problems, thrives in a collaborative environment, and is eager to expand your skills beyond Workday, this role will give you the platform to do just that.
This role will be based in Bangkok and relocation will be provided.
In this Role, you'll get to:
Serve as the Workday Benefits Specialist, leading the design, configuration, and maintenance of core benefits processes, eligibility rules, plans, and programs.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable Workday solutions that enhance employee experience.
Participate in testing cycles, release readiness activities, and continuous improvement initiatives to maximize Workday capabilities.
Own and manage reporting, calculated fields, and security configurations related to Benefits, ensuring data integrity and appropriate access levels.
Gain opportunities to work across other Workday domains and internal tools, expanding expertise based on project needs and personal interests.
Stay informed on new Workday releases and people technology trends, identifying opportunities for enhancement and automation.
Explore and contribute to other internal tools and technologies beyond Workday, expanding your technical footprint within the People Technology ecosystem.
What you'll Need to Succeed:
4 - 6 years of hands-on Workday experience, with at least 2–3 years focused on Benefits configuration and reporting
Deep expertise in Core Benefits setup including eligibility rules, enrollment events, and integrations with benefit providers.
Strong proficiency in Advanced Reporting and Calculated Fields, with the ability to build complex, cross-domain reports.
Solid understanding of HCM fundamentals, covering both business processes (Hire, Change Job, Termination) and configuration concepts (condition rules, orgs, hierarchies, custom objects)
Working knowledge of Workday Security, including constrained/unconstrained roles and segmented security
Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for process efficiency and data integrity.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and translate business needs into system design.
Bachelor's degree in HR, IT, Business Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
It's Great if you have:
Experience with Workday Open Enrollment or global benefits rollouts
Exposure to Workday integrations (EIBs) related to benefits or payroll.
Experience working in an international or fast-paced environment.
Workday certification(s) in HCM or Benefits
Interest in expanding knowledge beyond Workday into other people technology platforms and tools.
What you'll get:
Medical, dental, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit
Provident fund benefits, and life insurance
Flexibility to help you work in the way that's best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options.
Unlimited online learning access, several in-person development programs for each stage of your career, and career paths for management and individual contributors
The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.
A generous relocation package to help you get here comfortably.

title: Analista de Operações de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento
description:
A Stone:


Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país,  em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Nossa Cultura: 


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

 Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. 

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.  

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos. 

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso. 

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega. 

Como é ser uma pessoa Analista de Operações de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento:


Fazer parte desse time significa estar no centro da experiência de quem chega à nossa companhia. Você será responsável por criar jornadas de aprendizado que não apenas transmitam informação, mas que também gerem conexão, pertencimento e engajamento. É um papel estratégico para garantir que os novos talentos tenham uma capacitação contínua, consistente e positiva, refletindo diretamente na nossa cultura e nos nossos resultados.

Desafio central: Ser responsável pela gestão e sustentação dos produtos, garantindo a documentação completa de todas as etapas, o alinhamento com fornecedores e áreas internas, além do acompanhamento de indicadores e resultados para apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.

No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Garantir a documentação atualizada de todas as etapas dos produtos, assegurando clareza e padronização das informações;
  • Realizar o alinhamento contínuo com fornecedores, acompanhando demandas, entregas e ajustes necessários;
  • Acompanhar requisições e processos de compras em parceria com o time de FP&A;
  • Sugerir e implementar novas ferramentas e recursos que contribuam para a evolução e eficiência dos produtos;
  • Garantir a sustentação dos produtos junto à operação, apoiando o bom funcionamento no dia a dia;
  • Construir, consolidar e manter painéis de acompanhamento mensal no Looker Studio;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios mensais com os dados consolidados para a liderança.

O que esperamos de você: 

  • Vivência com metodologias de aprendizagem ativa ou design instrucional;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de apresentação e plataformas de aprendizagem digital (LMS, por exemplo);

Jornada de Trabalho: 

  • 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 | Segunda a Sexta.

Modelo/Local de trabalho: 

  • Presencial, Rio de Janeiro.

Nossos Benefícios:


Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Virtual Verde: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo

Gympass

Auxílio Creche - para crianças até  5 anos e 11 meses

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte 

Convênio SESC

Salário Fixo 

Remuneração Variável (em alguns cargos) 

  Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:


Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte

Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto. 

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills Geralmente essa etapa é composta por um papo sobre o desafio e um case com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone  


Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente 

#LI-HYBRID (híbrido)

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

title: Online English Teacher
description:
Are you a fluent Portuguese speaker looking to fill your days with meaningful online English teaching?

You love teaching English, but you're seeking more opportunities to connect with students, advance your professional growth, and earn a supplemental income. What if you could do all this while working from home and setting your own schedule?

Here's how this role works for you:

  • Flexible hours: Teach part-time (minimum 10 hrs/week) within service hours 06:00–20:00 ET (subject to Daylight Savings in ET/Miami) .
    Peak hours: Monday to Thursday 16:00–20:00 ET. (Must work a minimum of 6 hours).
    Saturdays: Work at least 2 hours between 06:00–20:00 ET.
    Shift options: Monday & Wednesday OR Tuesday & Thursday OR both pairs (same working hours for each pair).
  • Work from home: No commute, no stress. Teach from the comfort of your own space.
  • Regular Students: Teach young learners/teens
  • Professional growth: Access free training and development resources to enhance your teaching skills.

Master the art of online teaching through The Inspire Academy, our e-learning platform packed with fresh, trending courses to enhance your online teaching skills From foundational techniques to advanced mastery, courses offer learnings for educators at all levels, including a fully accredited 120-hour TEFL certification. Subscribe today for access to all  certified and non-certified courses PLUS weekly new course releases. Stay ahead in the ever-evolving world of online education 

Position Details:

  • Start Date: January 2026 (must be available for interviews, recruitment process to be concluded in Dec 2025)
  • Rate: $6 USD per hour.
  • Contract Type: Independent Service Provider with The Really Great Teacher Company.

Requirements

  • Fluent English (C1/C2 level) and Portuguese speaker.
  • 3+ years of online or in-class English teaching experience.
  • Accredited 120-hour+ TEFL/TESOL/CELTA certification OR
  • Bachelor's Degree in English, Translation, English Literature, or any other related field.
  • Familiarity with CEFR and ESL assessments.
  • Highly computer literate with excellent communication skills.
  • Clean criminal record.

Technical Requirements:

  • PC: Intel Core i5 CPU @2.40GHz (4 CPUs) or better, 8GB RAM or greater.
  • Internet: Stable fiber connection (20 Mbps upload/download) via LAN cable.
  • Backup Power: UPS with 4-5 hours of battery life (recommended for areas with frequent power interruptions).
  • Equipment: Noise-cancelling headset, HD webcam (720p), and a quiet, well-lit teaching space.

For more information, view our online ESL teacher's tech checklist.

Limited positions available Apply now and join a global community of educators who are making a difference—all from the comfort of home.

title: Gerente de Projetos (Gestão de Riscos e Segurança) - 10935
description:
Porque o desafio de desenvolver as melhores soluções para impulsionar o negócio de milhares de empresas é também o que nos
motiva para transformar nossas ideias em resultados, criando grandes experiências para as nossas pessoas e evoluindo o ecossistema tech.
Uma empresa GPTW que se orgulha das suas pessoas e que busca oferecer jornadas de crescimento, aprendizado e valorizando a diversidade de pessoas e de pensamentos.
Porque é mais que uma vaga. É uma vaga na Senior.
Sobre o Desafio
Somos uma equipe apaixonada por projetos, impulsionados pelo propósito de capacitar indivíduos e alavancar negócios da Senior Sistemas. Buscamos um profissional que tenha experiência em gerenciamento de projetos de serviços de média e alta complexidade, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, monitoramento e controle, gestão de custos e rentabilidade, controle de qualidade da entrega, gestão de recursos e acompanhamento da eficiência do trabalho em equipe, atendendo aos padrões de entrega estabelecidos em metodologia. Será preciso ter orientação para resultados utilizando a visão sistêmica, estratégica e de mercado aliados a sentimento de dono. Gerir e desenvolver os recursos através do planejamento, monitorar e acompanhar a eficiência do trabalho em equipe e negociar de forma assertiva, com clareza, gerindo possíveis conflitos. Essa oportunidade é para atuação presencial em uma de nossas filiais, com responsabilidade sobre projetos de Acesso e Segurança.
Principais Responsabilidades
Planejamento e Inicialização de Projetos;
Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, identificando objetivos, escopo, cronogramas e recursos necessários;
Supervisionar a execução diária de projetos, assegurando que as metas sejam atingidas;
Monitorar o progresso do projeto, ajustando planos conforme necessário para atender às mudanças nos requisitos;
Liderar dentro do projeto e motivar equipes multifuncionais, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho.
Manter comunicação transparente com todas as partes interessadas, fornecendo atualizações regulares sobre o status do projeto;
Conduzir avaliações pós-implementação para identificar lições aprendidas e oportunidades de melhoria.
Arquivar documentação relevante e garantir uma transição suave para a operação regular.
Que Esperamos De Você
Formação superior completa em Ciências da Computação, e ou Administração, e/ou Contábeis, e ou Economia, e ou Sistemas de Informação, e ou outros equivalentes à área de TI;
Vivência com Gerenciamento de Projetos de implantação de softwares;
Experiência com metodologia PMBOK;
Conhecimento ferramentas de software de gerenciamento de projetos;
Disponibilidade para viagens.
Que Pode Potencializar Sua Candidatura
Vivencia com projetos de Acesso e Segurança;
Cursos/certificações em negociação;
Certificação PMP/ACP ou Pós-Graduação em gerenciamento de projetos ou gestão estratégica;
Certificações em metodologias ágeis.
Nossos Benefícios
Convênio Médico e Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
PPLR - Participação nos lucros e resultados;
Cartão Wiipo com benefícios flexíveis;
Clube Wiipo com descontos e vantagens exclusivas;
TotalPass - Benefício de academias e bem-estar;
OnHappy - Benefício de vantagens para viagens;
Banco de horas;
Empresa cidadã: Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
Assistência natalidade;
Assistência PET;

Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira.
O Nosso Jeito Senior De Ser
Nossa cultura respeita as individualidades e potencializa as pessoas com inovação, colaboração e autonomia. Acreditamos na pluralidade, pois as experiências e perspectivas são únicas, com oportunidades que incluem diversidade de pessoas e de pensamentos. Porque é dessa forma que alcançamos grandes resultados, que geram o sucesso dos clientes, movidos pela dedicação de pessoas incríveis. Estas informações são específicas para esta oportunidade, mas você pode conferir todas as nossas vagas e ainda mais sobre como é ser Senior na nossa página de carreiras:
Somos mais Senior
Somos uma empresa brasileira reconhecida como uma das maiores desenvolvedoras de software para gestão do país. Com mais de 35 anos de história e atuação em todo o Brasil, impulsionamos a transformação digital de milhares de empresas por meio da tecnologia. Expandimos nossa presença para o mercado internacional com a aquisição de uma empresa na Colômbia, fortalecendo nossa atuação na América Latina. A qualidade das nossas soluções é resultado do trabalho de mais de 3.600 pessoas e de um portfólio completo voltado à alta performance. Guiados pelo propósito de Potencializar Pessoas e Impulsionar Negócios, conquistamos por oito vezes o reconhecimento como Great Place to Work. Seguimos crescendo de forma consistente, valorizando pessoas, cultura e colaboração, porque impulsionar o futuro faz parte do nosso jeito de ser.

title: Investor Services Senior Officer
description:
Investor Services (Cape Town)

Step into a leadership role within our Rio office, where you'll oversee investor onboarding, capital activity, and ongoing relationship management for our global
Private Equity
clients. You'll lead a high-performing team while ensuring that every investor interaction — from subscriptions to distributions — is executed with accuracy, accountability, and exceptional service.

In this role, you'll act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring all investor operations align with compliance and operational standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 7 years' experience in Investor Services or Fund Administration
  • Strong command of AML/KYC principles and investment regulatory environments
  • Proven team leadership and the ability to cultivate performance and engagement
  • Client-centric mindset with clear and confident communication skills
  • High attention to detail with strong documentation and control discipline
  • Comfortable working with investor portals, Microsoft 365 and workflow tools
  • English fluency; LATAM interaction

Where You'll Add Value

Client & Stakeholder Interaction

  • Act as the primary contact for investor servicing matters and SLA governance
  • Build strong and proactive communication channels with clients and partners
  • Guide investors and internal teams through complex operational queries

Systems & Onboarding

  • Drive the onboarding and transition of new funds and investors
  • Oversee full KYC/AML review processes and regulatory adherence
  • Ensure accurate data setup and ongoing system validation

Investor Operations

  • Approve and monitor investor transactions including capital calls, subscriptions, redemptions and distributions
  • Coordinate cash flow reconciliation and support treasury operations
  • Maintain robust allocation and documentation accuracy across investor accounts

Operational Accountability

Risk & Compliance Environment

  • Strengthen operational controls and ensure audit-ready records
  • Resolve discrepancies swiftly and escalate issues appropriately
  • Support regulatory updates and compliance change initiatives

Reporting & Year-End Deliverables

  • Facilitate investor reporting workflows and deliverables
  • Collaborate with auditors to provide accurate information packs
  • Uphold operational standards in line with industry best practices

Working Across the Business

You'll partner closely with Fund Accounting, Middle Office, Compliance, and wider business units to ensure seamless coordination across the full investor lifecycle and NAV process.

title: Administrador de Suporte Técnico (100  remoto)
description:
Somos a IPmedia
Uma startup de tecnologia com diversos produtos no mercado de encontros online, com mais de 10 anos de operação. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por tecnologia que deseja quebrar as barreiras de distância entre as pessoas, através de novas tendências e crescimento.
Em nosso ambiente colaborativo e inovador, enfatizamos a liberdade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo ou no conforto da sua própria casa, promovendo um livre fluxo de ideias. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento e o crescimento de nossos profissionais, oferecendo cursos de treinamento e oportunidades de aprendizado. Trabalhamos com tecnologias de ponta, tanto no desenvolvimento quanto na infraestrutura.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Administrador(a) de Suporte Técnico para atuar remotamente e garantir a gestão eficiente, segura e padronizada dos dispositivos da empresa. Esse papel é essencial para manter a operação fluida, com foco em automação, manutenção remota, segurança da informação e suporte técnico ágil ao time, contribuindo diretamente para a escalabilidade e confiabilidade do nosso ambiente de TI.
Requisitos:
Somos uma pequena e crescente empresa de tecnologia em busca de um Analista de Suporte Técnico para integrar nossa equipe. Nesta função, você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com o nosso Administrador de Suporte Técnico para garantir que nossos processos de suporte evoluam à medida que continuamos a escalar nossas operações diárias. Procuramos um Especialista em Suporte Técnico com ampla experiência em gerenciamento remoto de computadores, implantação de imagens, atualizações remotas, limpeza e reinicializações de sistemas para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por otimizar a configuração, manutenção e segurança dos dispositivos da empresa, garantindo a máxima eficiência no gerenciamento remoto de equipamentos e soluções de TI.
Responsabilidades:
Usando ferramentas de acesso remoto como AnyDesk, monitoro, acesso e mantenho mais de 60 computadores e outros dispositivos remotos.
Redefinir e garantir a limpeza e segurança dos sistemas remotos, incluindo o uso de ferramentas de exclusão de dados, garantindo conformidade com padrões de segurança e regulamentos de proteção de dados.
Manter a documentação de processos limpa e atualizada.
Automatizar e gerenciar o processo de atualização de sistemas operacionais e softwares críticos, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam sempre atualizados e protegidos contra vulnerabilidades.
Desenvolver e manter imagens padrão para sistemas operacionais e configurações de software, automatizando a implantação em novos dispositivos.
Fornecer suporte técnico remoto para resolver problemas de software, hardware e rede, garantindo que as operações comerciais continuem de forma suave.
Organizar os tickets enviados pela equipe e classificá-los ou categorizá-los, quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status de serviço.
Requisitos:
Experiência prévia em gerenciamento de TI, com ênfase em ambientes remotos.
Conhecimento em Microsoft Endpoint Manager (SCCM), RDP e AnyDesk.
Experiência na criação e manutenção de imagens de sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux, macOS).
Conhecimento em ferramentas de segurança e exclusão de dados, como DBAN e Secure Erase.
Capacidade de gerenciar e aplicar atualizações remotas em sistemas e softwares críticos.
Bom conhecimento de protocolos de segurança, como VPN, firewalls, antivírus e criptografia.
Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e resolver problemas técnicos remotamente com agilidade.
Desejável:
Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (Azure, AWS) e soluções de gerenciamento em nuvem.
Benefícios
Por que se juntar a nós?
Flexibilidade no trabalho: Escolha seu espaço de trabalho, seja seu escritório em casa ou seu café favorito.
Aprendizado contínuo: Estamos comprometidos com o seu crescimento. Acesse uma variedade de cursos e workshops.

title: Delayed Coker Visbreaker Specialist-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
You will also have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
